Azokle is engineered on a zero-knowledge architecture. We do not log your searches, track your IP address, store browser fingerprints, or sell user telemetry. All history and session cookies remain encrypted on your device and can be permanently incinerated with a single tap.
Azokle Search and Privacy Browser is provided free of charge under a privacy-first guarantee. By using Azokle, you agree not to use the service for malicious activities or automated abuse.

Azokle is a sovereign, decentralized, privacy-first search engine and secure mobile browser. Engineered with sub-millisecond Radix Trie ad/tracker blocking, 3rd-party cookie isolation, encrypted local vaults, and full multi-tab reading support.
